label: Quito — historic center and Andes panorama
title: File:Vista de Quito desde El Panecillo, Ecuador, 2015-07-22, DD 25-29 PAN.JPG
author: Diego Delso
description: View of Quito, capital of Ecuador, from El Panecillo. The city population is about 1,620,000 inhabitants and due to the orography of the region the city has a particular longish form.
note: An expansive city-and-mountain view from El Panecillo; historic-center landmarks are smaller than in the basilica view.
